_comment: Row 293. Re-run from a detached scratch copy with toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row293_ipv6_measured_pass_reachable.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. Seven exact-once regressions cover the formerly swallowed expected address, run_all_probes family routing, normalized equality, mismatch refusal, the v1282 IPv4-fallback hold, and API forwarding. The separate transform-control spec applies the identical M1 signature regression to an import-only test and must ESCAPE.
